narrative: A chat message claims to be from Income Tax Department regarding refund audit.

message.body: Income Tax Refund Notice: Tax refund of ₹12,400 for Assessment Year 2025-26 approved. Verify bank account details at http://incometax-refund-portal.org

evidence.label: Official e-Filing Portal (incometax.gov.in)
evidence.value: Official portal refund status shows 'No pending refund verification'.

consequence_text.safe: Checking the official government portal confirmed no tax refund verification was pending.
consequence_text.unsafe: Submitting bank details on fake tax portals leads to credential theft.

teaching_point: Government tax refunds are processed exclusively on government .gov.in portals.
